title: EmailFilterCondition non_exhaustive blocks field-setting from external crates
description: EmailFilterCondition is #[non_exhaustive] with only a Default impl. External callers can get an all-None condition via ::default() but CANNOT set any fields — functional record update syntax (MyType { field: val, ..Default::default() }) is forbidden by #[non_exhaustive] from outside the defining crate. Client code in jmap-mail-client cannot construct filter conditions with specific field values. Fix: add EmailFilterCondition::new() returning Default::default() as a starting point is insufficient; callers need either field-setting builder methods or remove #[non_exhaustive] from this input type.
